title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Brainstorm Force CartFlows up to version 3.3.2. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of a victim's browser.
